svg.text: $ npx context-doctor savings
What context-doctor finds in your Claude Code sessions
Last 30 days, 29 sessions, priced at list prices
Input you were billed for $6,057 from your transcripts' usage
1. Compact when you come back $2,714 (45%)
192 returns to a session over 150k tokens after the prompt cache
expired. Running /compact then, net of the compaction itself, would
have saved this. The every-prompt hook points these moments out, in
every Claude Code surface, the desktop app included.
2. Autopilot n/a
All 29 sessions ran in the desktop app, which sets its own API
address, so the autopilot proxy cannot sit in front of them. In a
terminal or an IDE they would have saved $793 (12.9%).
3. Compact earlier (400k window) $3,362 (56%)
Claude Code's own auto-compact window: automatic in every surface,
14.7 compactions a week instead of 5.1. Each keeps a summary, not the
full history. Compare sizes: context-doctor compact-window
Set it with: context-doctor compact-window 400k
Replayed request by request through the shipped code and priced as the
prompt cache bills. On a subscription the same tokens come out of your
usage limit instead. Share yours: context-doctor savings --share
